'''1997 Decipher World Championship First Anthology Sealed''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed tournament at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]] (5–7 December 1997, Norfolk Marriott Waterside Hotel, Norfolk, Virginia). Decipher billed it the Star Wars CCG First Anthology Sealed Deck tournament.<ref name="dec-report1">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/report1.html Star Wars Finalists Arrive in Norfolk], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980224024525/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/report1.html Internet Archive]</ref> Forty of the World Finals invitees played Sunday 7 December, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., while the twelve semi-finalists played constructed.<ref name="dec-sealed">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sealedsummary.html Report 10], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980223172645/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sealedsummary.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Kyle Kessenich]] of California defeated [[Colin McCann]] of Ontario in the final. Kessenich's prize was a complete set of Japanese-language Premiere cards.<ref name="dec-sealed" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' [[First Anthology Sealed]] consolation
* '''Format:''' [[First Anthology Sealed]]
* '''Date:''' 7 December 1997
* '''Site:''' Norfolk Marriott Waterside Hotel, Norfolk, Virginia
* '''Players:''' 40
* '''Swiss:''' four preliminary games, 2 victory points for a win plus Force differential
* '''Final:''' Kessenich vs McCann
* '''Product:''' a [[First Anthology]] set signed by Decipher's product development team. Decipher wrote there were only fifty-two sets like it.
